（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

June 26th 1916

Sir,

It is reported that the Commanders of certain
cruisers have demanded the punishment of the monarchical
plotters and have threatened to bombard Woosung if their
demand is not granted.

It is reported that the Kuomingtang party is
forming a compact with Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang
whereby the party undertakes to assist Feng as a
candidate for the Vice Presidency and the latter
undertakes to help them to force the Central Government
to punish the monarchical plotters.

Six field guns and 1,000 rifles were sent from
the Arsenal by train to Peking on 26th inst.

General Yang visited Sungkiang yesterday.

Your Obedient Servant,

Minnie Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered amnd. June 26.

刑事调查处
外交部 409室
16年6月26日
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年6月26日

先生：

据报，某些巡洋舰的指挥官要求惩办帝制阴谋分子，并威胁称，若其要求未获满足，将炮轰吴淞。

据报，国民党正与张作霖、冯国璋达成密约，据此该党承诺支持冯氏竞选副总统，而冯氏则承诺协助该党迫使中央政府惩办帝制阴谋分子。

本月26日，兵工厂经铁路向北京运送了六门野战炮和一千支步枪。

杨将军昨日访问了松江。

您顺从的仆人，

米妮·阿姆斯特朗 (Minnie Armstrong)
总探长

警察总监

于6月26日上午录入并修正。
